title: Much better than expected

title: Thanks to Anna, our Guide, for a...
text: Thanks to Anna, our Guide, for a very enjoyable and fascinating introduction to the city and its history, and the area of Albaicin in particular. From Plaza San Nicolas, just before sunset, we saw the Alhambra's walls shining red. We were also introduced to some Bodegas and cafe-bars along the way.
author: Richard Goody

title: Our tour guide was awesome! Very...
text: Our tour guide was awesome! Very friendly and knowledgeable about Granada. Definitely recommend.
author: Stephanie F

title: We had a great time on this relaxed...
text: We had a great time on this relaxed tapas walking tour! Our guide, Victor was knowledgeable, charming and took us to great little local places through routes we definitely wouldn't have found on our own. The finale was the beautifully atmospheric Alhambra lit up in the late evening. This was a lovely family memory and one of the highlights of our holiday.
author: DAVID F

title: One of the best tours we did in our...
text: One of the best tours we did in our trip to Spain was the Granada Tapas tour offered by Viator. Was skeptical to book at first given that other tapas tours were reviewed more highly, but this one was awesome. Emilio was our guide for the evening and he took us around the city and up into the Albaicin for amazing views, especially of the Alhambra. We stopped at 4 different Tapas places which were all different and fun. I would say that this is about 2/3 walking and 1/3 tapas, so if you are looking for just the food and drink, it may not be for you. But it was perfect for our first night
author: Chris B

title: Victor was an excellent guide.  His...
text: Victor was an excellent guide. His knowledge of the history of the area was fascinating and the tapas and wines were great. I would highly recommend this tour and Victor!
